era: Jurassic, reference species P. lirata Upper Bathonian
claim_scope: Original genus-level Jurassic fossil-form study informed by Pholadomya lirata photographs from Sztajner 2020, Figures 12D and 1D/E, across different specimens. Not a scan, digital twin or measured single-specimen reconstruction.
origin: Floor-contact centered museum presentation, not an in-life position.
axes: Blender X anterior to posterior (+X posterior), Y valve depth, Z dorsal. Anatomical side camera -Y, posterior camera +X. After glTF conversion, posterior +X, dorsal +Y, valve depth +/-Z.

scale.basis: Artistic nominal scale, not transcribed or measured reference length. All other dimensions inferred from multi-specimen form.

profile: palette-only static closed solids; two separate editable valve meshes; continuous raised geometry ribs and a natural posterior assembly opening
criteria: Elongate inflated shell, short elevated anterior and longer tapering posterior.
Sweeping radial relief ribs continuously joined to the valve surface, strongest on anterior and middle.
Two separately manifold thick valve solids, inward-facing cavity surfaces and narrow posterior gape; not a fully sealed generic bivalve.
No soft tissue, pearl, siphon, hinge teeth, invented specimen accession or original pigment claim.
Reference 12D and 1D/E only for selected species; excluded third-party H/I are not model references.
required_self_checks: static GLB and official Khronos format
separate_required_review: independent visual, factual, specification and technical review

concept.use: Art direction only; photos and prep contract override it.
